text:
maria_gonzalez: Hi @people-ops -- FYI I flew back to the UK for a 4-month remote stint starting 2026-05-01. My March paycheck (4/15) shows US federal tax and FICA withheld even though I updated my address in Rippling and uploaded the assignment approval. Did the UK payroll transition go through?

sarah (People Ops): Thanks for the heads up, Maria. We should have routed you to UK payroll / contractor conversion. Can you confirm which address you set in Rippling and attach the mobility approval doc?

maria_gonzalez: I updated address to: 12 Baker St, London, W1U and attached the Global Mobility approval on 2026-04-02 (screenshot). Link: https://app.rippling.example/employee/mg/docs/mobility-approval.pdf

diego (Payroll): Looking at the run: March 31 payroll was processed under US US_EMP code. The residency flag didn't flip in Rippling before the run cutoff (4/01 11:59 PM PT). That caused regular US withholding and employer FICA entries.

emily (Global Mobility): Hi all  we initiated the UK onboarding (PAYE) on 2026-04-05 but it requires HMRC registration and a payroll start date. Because Rippling still had the US record active at cutoff, the first UK run missed the employee. Apologies, Maria.

maria_gonzalez: Ugh. So will I be double-taxed in March? I'm not a US citizen and won't file US 1040. I shouldn't be paying FICA.

diego (Payroll): Short answer: we will correct. Options: (1) Off-cycle reversal for US withholdings + reissue via UK payroll (if UK vendor can back-pay), or (2) provide a supplemental refund through US payroll and coordinate with Global Mobility for UK gross-up if needed. We need to confirm nominee UK payroll can process back-period PAYE.

emily (Global Mobility): I've started conversations with our UK payroll partner. They can do a mid-period onboarding and run retro PAYE for the April pay date, but we need your right-to-work docs and the signed assignment letter.

sarah (People Ops): For records: please DM the RTW docs and confirm passport/visa. Also, Rippling team: please set employee residency = UK effective 2026-05-01 and flag for off-cycle correction.

rippling-bot: Payroll note created: Ticket#PL-9921: residency change request for user maria_gonzalez, effective 2026-05-01.

diego (Payroll): Maria, we'll credit back FICA and federal withholdings on an off-cycle refund (taxable reversal lines) on next US cycle and annotate the stub "US withholding reversal - relocation to UK". Expect net deposit adjustment. We'll coordinate with Global Mobility for the UK grossing if UK payroll can't retroactively cover employee-side taxes.

maria_gonzalez: Thanks. Will this affect my 2026 W-2 or will there be a 1042-S or other form? I'm trying to sort with my tax adviser.

emily (Global Mobility): Since you are nonresident and UK-based after 5/1, US wages after that date won't be US-sourced. For the earnings paid in March that were taxed in the US, Payroll will issue corrected wage statements and coordinate whether a corrected W-2 is needed. If you're nonresident alien for the year, we might need Form 1042-S instead for certain payments, but we'll confirm with tax. We'll loop in tax@redwood.

diego (Payroll): We'll generate YTD adjustment docs and run a reconciliation with Tax. If a corrected W-2 or other forms are required, we'll notify you before year-end. For now, expect the off-cycle reversal posted 2026-05-10 and a confirmation email.

sarah (People Ops): Apologies again, Maria. We're treating this high priority. Emily and Diego will follow up with a checklist for documents and timeline.

emily (Global Mobility): Checklist I'll send: RTW docs, signed assignment, passport photo page, bank details for UK pay, and completed UK starter checklist. ETA for UK payroll partner response: 48-72 hrs.

maria_gonzalez: Got it, sending RTW now. Appreciate the quick responses. :pray:
